assessment: This study reports on the circuits contributing to impairment in attention in absence epilepsy linked to reduced Scn8A expression. Using a novel attentional engagement task, the evidence supporting the main conclusions is solid and well-sampled. The results provide a starting point for future experiments to assess functional impairments in parvalbumin-positive interneurons and gamma activity with attention in models of absence seizures and mental health disorders.
